name: CVE-2026-24512-nginx-ingress-path-rules-config-injection
description: CVE-2026-24512 is a critical vulnerability in ingress-nginx controller that allows attackers to inject nginx configuration via the rules.http.paths.path Ingress field, leading to arbitrary code execution and disclosure of Secrets.
remediation: Upgrade ingress-nginx to v1.13.7, v1.14.3, or newer versions. Alternatively, deploy a validating admission controller to reject Ingress resources with ImplementationSpecific path types.
test: The control checks for vulnerable versions of ingress-nginx controller (all versions prior to v1.13.7, and v1.14.0 through v1.14.2).
long_description: CVE-2026-24512 is a critical security flaw affecting ingress-nginx with a CVSS v3.1 score of 8.8. The vulnerability allows attackers to exploit the rules.http.paths.path Ingress field to inject nginx configuration. This can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the ingress-nginx controller and disclosure of Secrets accessible to the controller. In default configurations, the ingress-nginx controller has cluster-wide Secret access, making the potential impact severe. The vulnerability affects all versions prior to v1.13.7 and versions v1.14.0 through v1.14.2.
